articles.title_en: Innovation by regulation: Smart electricity in Great Britain and Italy
articles.title_cn: 监管创新：英国和意大利的智能电力
articles.abstract_en: With the rise of renewable and distributed energy sources, electricity distribution and transmission utilities are facing increasing demand by regulators to innovate and adopt new technologies and transit to smart grids. However, these regulated natural monopolies often lack economic incentives to develop and adopt new technologies. To overcome this barrier, some regulatory authorities have introduced the so-called “innovation-stimuli” regulations to foster experimentation, technological adoption and innovative solutions. We analyze and compare the effectiveness of two different innovation-stimuli regulations, the cost-pass through and WACC approaches, in Great Britain (GB) and Italy, respectively. To assess the impact of these different regulations on innovation, we use synthetic control (SC) and synthetic difference-in-differences (SDID) methods, which constitute causal inference techniques for small-n case study design and, for the first time, are employed to assess the impact of regulations on innovation outputs. Our panel data encompasses 13 European countries covering 1995 to 2013 and used smart grid projects and patent applications as dependent variables. Meanwhile, cost-pass-through significantly and positively affected patent applications in the GB. In Italy, WACC did not affect patent applications, and European Commission-funded projects mostly drove the increases in smart-grid projects.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着可再生能源和分布式能源的兴起，电力配电和输电公用事业面临着监管机构日益增长的要求，即创新并采用新技术，向智能电网过渡。然而，这些受监管的自然垄断企业往往缺乏经济激励来开发和采用新技术。为了克服这一障碍，一些监管机构引入了所谓的“创新激励”监管，以促进实验、技术采用和创新解决方案。我们分析并比较了英国和意大利分别采用的两种不同的创新激励监管——成本转嫁和加权平均资本成本方法的有效性。为了评估这些不同监管对创新的影响，我们使用了合成控制和合成双重差分方法，这些方法构成了小样本案例研究的因果推断技术，并且首次被用于评估监管对创新产出的影响。我们的面板数据涵盖13个欧洲国家，时间跨度为1995年至2013年，并使用智能电网项目和专利申请作为因变量。同时，成本转嫁显著且积极地影响了英国的专利申请。在意大利，加权平均资本成本并未影响专利申请，而欧盟委员会资助的项目主要推动了智能电网项目的增加。

articles.title_en: How heterogeneity in perceived external benefits differently affects federal and state efforts to address climate change
articles.title_cn: 感知外部收益的异质性如何不同地影响联邦和州应对气候变化的努力
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores how heterogeneity across policymakers and the jurisdictions they represent, such as in their perceived external benefits from reducing greenhouse gas emissions, affects state and federal efforts to address climate change. State governments restrict their emissions anticipating spillback and the impact of their choice on trade flows. Federally, legislators restrict national emissions and distribute green pork to secure key votes. Heterogeneity gives rise to differential distortions across levels of the federation reflecting political failure. As a result, the central state policy undershoots mitigation relative to the conditionally Pareto optimal level using a central estimate of the global social cost of carbon whereas the central federal policy overshoots. Moreover, these policies achieve nearly the same amount of true surplus gains possible, 72.4% and 72.7%, respectively. State policies tend to be less regressive and provide true surplus gains to states that choose not to mitigate, whereas federal policy is likely to deliver losses to no voting districts. Taken together these results indicate that its possible for state policy to yield greater societal welfare than federal policy when policies generate transboundary spillovers and that there exists complex linkages between the relative political failure, emissions, efficiency, and equity impacts of policies selected across levels of the federation as a result of heterogeneity.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了政策制定者及其所代表的辖区之间的异质性，例如他们在减少温室气体排放方面的感知外部收益差异，如何影响州和联邦应对气候变化的努力。州政府限制其排放，预期到回溢效应及其选择对贸易流动的影响。在联邦层面，立法者限制全国排放并分配绿色猪肉以争取关键选票。异质性导致联邦各层级出现反映政治失败的差异性扭曲。因此，使用全球社会碳成本的中央估计值，中央州政策相对于条件帕累托最优水平的减缓力度不足，而中央联邦政策则过度减缓。此外，这些政策实现的真实剩余收益几乎相同，分别为72.4%和72.7%。州政策往往不那么累退，并为选择不减缓的州提供真实剩余收益，而联邦政策则可能给无投票区带来损失。综合来看，这些结果表明，当政策产生跨界溢出效应时，州政策可能比联邦政策带来更大的社会福利，并且由于异质性，联邦各层级所选政策的相对政治失败、排放、效率和公平影响之间存在复杂的联系。

articles.title_en: Assessing energy transition using exponential production technology under different convexity assumptions
articles.title_cn: 在不同凸性假设下使用指数生产技术评估能源转型
articles.abstract_en: Environmentally sustainable development necessitates striking a balance between reducing carbon emissions and fostering economic growth. Despite their role in shaping both environmental and economic performance outcomes, energy consumption patterns and their impact on sustainable growth have not received the attention they deserve in the performance assessment literature. Approaches used to model production technologies using a network of separate processes often overlook the constraints that must be imposed on energy structure when energy use is treated as a pollution-generating input, potentially leading to biased policy recommendations. This study addresses this gap by extending the so-called by-production technology model (Murty et al., 2012). We define the exponential model of by-production with respect to both convex and non-convex technology and assume identical energy consumption and structure across different processes comprising the by-production model. Our analysis of the performance across a sample of countries between 2000 and 2019 demonstrates that omitting these constraints overestimates inefficiency, or the performance improvement potential. Results suggest that environmental inefficiency generally exceeds economic inefficiency. Moreover, most nations show progressively heavier reliance on carbon-emitting energy sources, suggesting a significant potential for transitioning to cleaner alternatives in the future. Finally, we find that performance trajectories are similar under different convexity assumptions.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境可持续发展需要在减少碳排放和促进经济增长之间取得平衡。尽管能源消费模式及其对可持续增长的影响在塑造环境和经济绩效结果方面发挥着作用，但在绩效评估文献中并未得到应有的关注。使用一系列独立过程来模拟生产技术的现有方法，在将能源使用视为产生污染的投入时，往往忽视了必须对能源结构施加的约束，可能导致有偏见的政策建议。本研究通过扩展所谓的副生产技术模型（Murty等人，2012）来填补这一空白。我们定义了关于凸和非凸技术的指数副生产模型，并假设构成副生产模型的不同过程具有相同的能源消费和结构。我们对2000至2019年间一组国家绩效的分析表明，忽略这些约束会高估低效率或绩效改进潜力。结果表明，环境低效率通常超过经济低效率。此外，大多数国家显示出对碳排放能源来源的依赖逐渐加重，表明未来向更清洁替代能源转型具有显著潜力。最后，我们发现不同凸性假设下的绩效轨迹相似。

articles.title_en: Operating profit of pumped hydroelectric plants operating under uncertainty
articles.title_cn: 不确定性条件下运行的抽水蓄能电站的运营利润
articles.abstract_en: This paper develops a measure of performance for pumped hydroelectric plants that accounts for uncertainties in the production environment. This uncertainty is characterised in terms of different possible states of Nature (e.g., amounts of rainfall). The decision-making process of plant managers is then broken into two stages. In the first stage, plant managers must choose variable inputs (e.g., labour and materials) to maximise expected operating profit in the face of uncertainty about the state of Nature. In the second stage, after variable inputs have been chosen and the state of Nature has been revealed, the plant manager must choose the amounts of energy to sell and store to maximise revenue. The associated measure of performance compares observed operating profit with the operating profit that would have been obtained if the manager had made the optimising choices in both stages. The empirical feasibility of the methodology is demonstrated using a data envelopment analysis (DEA) estimator and data from pumped hydroelectric plants in Italy. In this application, the decisions that plant managers make in the first stage are found to have a larger impact on profits than the decisions they make in the second stage.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文开发了一种衡量抽水蓄能电站绩效的方法，该方法考虑了生产环境中的不确定性。这种不确定性以不同的自然状态（例如，降雨量）为特征。随后，电站管理者的决策过程被分为两个阶段。在第一阶段，管理者必须选择可变投入（例如，劳动力和材料），以在面对自然状态不确定性时最大化预期运营利润。在第二阶段，在可变投入已选定且自然状态已揭示后，管理者必须选择出售和储存的能量数量以最大化收入。相关的绩效衡量方法将观察到的运营利润与如果管理者在两个阶段都做出最优选择时本应获得的运营利润进行比较。该方法的实证可行性通过数据包络分析（DEA）估计器和意大利抽水蓄能电站的数据得到展示。在此应用中，发现管理者在第一阶段做出的决策对利润的影响大于第二阶段做出的决策。

articles.title_en: How to motivate clean production transformation?—a theoretical framework by game theory approach
articles.title_cn: 如何激励清洁生产转型？——基于博弈论方法的理论框架
articles.abstract_en: Clean production transformation is critical for sustainable development, yet limited research has addressed how public policies can incentivize firms to voluntarily adopt such practices. This paper bridges this gap by developing a game-theoretic framework featuring a government and two symmetric firms engaged in sequential strategy selection. The analysis reveals that a strategically designed minimum investment threshold is critical: while the government can induce voluntary CPT adoption via this mechanism, excessively high thresholds will deter firms from participating altogether. Sensitivity analyses further demonstrate distinct policy implications: 27% stricter minimum investment thresholds and 44% less subsidies are sufficient to effectively motivate CPT investments for labor-intensive firms, whereas capital-intensive firms are less responsive to such measures. In addition, tax exemptions and reduced supervision costs have minimal impact on firms’ optimal choices. However, tax incentives allow governments to set stricter thresholds, a doubled tax exemption triggers 67.9% subsidy cuts and 46.3% investment threshold increase. Lower supervision costs alleviate financing burdens without compromising policy efficacy.
articles.abstract_cn: 清洁生产转型对可持续发展至关重要，但关于公共政策如何激励企业自愿采纳此类实践的研究有限。本文通过构建一个包含政府与两家对称企业进行序贯策略选择的博弈论框架来弥补这一空白。分析揭示，战略设计的最低投资门槛至关重要：虽然政府可以通过这一机制诱导企业自愿采纳清洁生产转型，但过高的门槛将阻止企业完全参与。敏感性分析进一步展示了不同的政策含义：对于劳动密集型企业，27%更严格的最低投资门槛和44%更少的补贴足以有效激励清洁生产转型投资，而资本密集型企业对此类措施反应较弱。此外，税收减免和降低监管成本对企业最优选择的影响微乎其微。然而，税收激励允许政府设定更严格的门槛，双倍的税收减免会引发67.9%的补贴削减和46.3%的投资门槛提高。较低的监管成本在不损害政策效果的前提下减轻了融资负担。

articles.title_en: Investment incentives in a wholesale electricity market with storage
articles.title_cn: 含储能的批发电力市场中的投资激励
articles.abstract_en: This paper explores the role of markets in facilitating the transition to renewable energy sources. It investigates the effectiveness of a wholesale market design in which all electricity is traded on the spot market to provide price signals that encourage investments in renewable generation and storage during this transition. To do this, we develop a model that represents a two-period electricity sector, distinguishing between daytime and nighttime, where a fossil fuel generator competes with a renewable (solar) generator that has zero marginal cost during the daytime. In the absence of storage, we analyze the impact of price caps and competition on incentivizing investments in renewable generation. We then introduce the storage of electricity during the daytime to supply it during nighttime, considering both an independent operator and an integrated renewable generation-storage operator. Our key finding is that incorporating storage for renewable generators leads to larger initial investments in renewable generation and substitution of fossil fuel generation by (stored) renewable generation at nighttime. We also show that achieving second-best outcomes requires competition to work, and in its absence, appropriately chosen price caps are required. This paper identifies the need for both minimum prices for limiting the exercise of market power when demand is low and maximum prices for limiting exercise of market power when demand is high.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文探讨了市场在促进向可再生能源转型中的作用。它研究了一种批发市场设计的有效性，在该设计中，所有电力都在现货市场上交易，以提供价格信号，鼓励在转型期间对可再生能源发电和储能的投资。为此，我们开发了一个代表两期电力部门的模型，区分白天和夜间，其中化石燃料发电机与白天边际成本为零的可再生（太阳能）发电机竞争。在没有储能的情况下，我们分析了价格上限和竞争对激励可再生能源发电投资的影响。然后，我们引入白天储存电力以供夜间使用的情况，同时考虑独立运营商和一体化可再生能源发电-储能运营商。我们的主要发现是，将储能纳入可再生能源发电会导致可再生能源发电的初始投资更大，并在夜间用（储存的）可再生能源发电替代化石燃料发电。我们还表明，实现次优结果需要竞争发挥作用，而在缺乏竞争的情况下，需要适当选择的价格上限。本文指出了需要最低价格以限制需求低时市场势力的行使，以及最高价格以限制需求高时市场势力的行使。

articles.title_en: Porter Hypothesis vs. Pollution Haven Hypothesis: Can an environmental policy generate a win–win solution?
articles.title_cn: 波特假说与污染天堂假说：环境政策能否产生双赢解决方案？
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the effects of environmental policy on firms’ location and green innovation for a two-country, two-firm model. To address this issue, a two-stage game is solved. At the first stage, firms can choose between three actions: to stay in the home country and invest in a green technology; to stay in the home country and produce with the business-as-usual technology; or to move to a pollution haven. At the second stage, the firms compete in quantities while serving the demand in the home country. Despite the model is symmetric, our findings indicate that all market configurations – both symmetric and asymmetric – can be a subgame perfect Nash equilibrium of the game. This includes a “win–win” solution where both firms choose to stay in the home country and invest in green technology confirming the “weak” version of the Porter Hypothesis. Remarkably, this outcome can occur even in seemingly adverse conditions with relatively low setup costs of relocating to a pollution haven. The model predicts that a stricter environmental policy plays in favor of the Porter Hypothesis because the “win–win” solution becomes more likely to arise as an equilibrium of the game. Our analysis examines two policy scenarios – an emission tax and an emission standard – finding that the emission tax can induce firms to stay and invest in green technology under circumstances for which the standard cannot, confirming in this way the “narrow” version of the Porter Hypothesis.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究环境政策对企业选址和绿色创新的影响，采用一个两国、两企业的模型。为解决此问题，我们求解了一个两阶段博弈。在第一阶段，企业可以在三种行动中选择：留在母国并投资绿色技术；留在母国并使用常规技术生产；或迁移至污染天堂。在第二阶段，企业在满足母国需求的同时进行产量竞争。尽管模型是对称的，我们的研究结果表明，所有市场配置——包括对称和不对称的——都可以成为博弈的子博弈完美纳什均衡。这包括一种“双赢”解决方案，即两家企业都选择留在母国并投资绿色技术，从而证实了波特假说的“弱”版本。值得注意的是，即使在看似不利的条件下，如迁移至污染天堂的设立成本相对较低时，这一结果也可能出现。模型预测，更严格的环境政策有利于波特假说，因为“双赢”解决方案作为博弈均衡出现的可能性更大。我们的分析考察了两种政策情景——排放税和排放标准——发现排放税可以在标准无法实现的情况下诱导企业留在母国并投资绿色技术，从而以这种方式证实了波特假说的“窄”版本。

articles.title_en: Carbon credit and credibility in lawsuit: Evidence from CCER firms in China
articles.title_cn: 碳信用与诉讼中的可信度：来自中国CCER企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper evaluates the China Certified Emission Reduction (CCER) program, a voluntary carbon reduction initiative, with a focus on the legal management practices of participating firms. We leverage several novel datasets, including firm-level litigation, financial, and environmental data, covering the period from 2014 to 2021. We have several main findings: First, CCER firms experience a significant reduction in legal liabilities reflected by decreased frequency of lawsuits in which firms are litigated and reduced claim points and claim amounts associated with these lawsuits. Second, firms holding CCER carbon credits significantly enhance their legal defense capabilities with a higher success rate in lawsuits and a notable reduction in both the ratio of claim points and the amounts upheld by courts. Our mechanism analysis also indicates that CCER firms achieve a significant reduction in CO2 emissions, air pollutant discharges, and environmental fees, as well as stronger financial positions, effectively reducing the risk of legal liabilities. The advantageous position of CCER firms are particularly prominent in financial defaults, contract, and labor disputes.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文评估了中国核证自愿减排量（CCER）项目，这是一项自愿性碳减排倡议，重点关注参与企业的法律管理实践。我们利用了多个新颖的数据集，包括企业层面的诉讼、财务和环境数据，覆盖了从2014年到2021年的时期。我们有几个主要发现：第一，CCER企业的法律负债显著减少，表现为企业涉诉频率下降，以及相关诉讼的索赔点和索赔金额减少。第二，持有CCER碳信用的企业显著增强了其法律辩护能力，诉讼成功率更高，法院支持的索赔点比例和金额均显著降低。我们的机制分析还表明，CCER企业实现了二氧化碳排放、空气污染物排放和环境费用的显著减少，以及更强的财务状况，有效降低了法律负债风险。CCER企业的优势地位在金融违约、合同和劳动纠纷中尤为突出。

articles.title_en: Is energy system resilience improved in the energy transition? Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 能源转型是否提升了能源系统韧性？来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: Improving energy resilience, as a crucial strategy to resist the risk associated with energy systems in the context of increasing uncertainty, is a meaningful research direction whether it can be realized during the energy transition phase. This study empirically assesses the correlation between energy transition and energy resilience. It also explores their heterogeneity and the potential impact mechanisms using balanced panel data for 30 provinces in 17 years in China. The results are as follows: (i) Energy transition can enhance the resilience of the energy system; (ii) there is regional heterogeneity in this positive boosting effect, and the differences are due to the different types of renewable energy sources; (iii) green technology innovation and green finance are effective mediators between energy transition and energy resilience. Some effective and practical policy suggestions are proposed, and policymakers should uphold the principle of adapting to local conditions and a systematic regional differentiation policy.
articles.abstract_cn: 提升能源韧性，作为在不确定性增加的背景下抵御能源系统相关风险的关键策略，在能源转型阶段能否实现是一个有意义的研究方向。本研究利用中国30个省份17年的平衡面板数据，实证评估了能源转型与能源韧性之间的相关性，并探讨了其异质性及潜在影响机制。结果如下：（i）能源转型能够增强能源系统的韧性；（ii）这种正向促进效应存在区域异质性，差异源于可再生能源类型的不同；（iii）绿色技术创新和绿色金融是能源转型与能源韧性之间的有效中介变量。本文提出了一些有效且实用的政策建议，政策制定者应坚持因地制宜的原则和系统性的区域差异化政策。

articles.title_en: Evaluating Norway’s electric vehicle incentives
articles.title_cn: 评估挪威的电动汽车激励措施
articles.abstract_en: We use car registration data from 2000 to 2021, as well as price lists and tax rules, to evaluate Norway’s incentives for consumers to choose electric vehicles. These include taxes on fossil fuels, EV exemption from car purchase taxes, and other incentives, like discounts on road tolls. We find that undoing the incentive with the largest effect, the EV exemption from purchase taxes, would reduce the EV market share to 25 percent from the 66 percent observed in 2021, increase CO2 emissions of new cars sold by 167 percent, reduce their total weight by 22 percent, and reduce the number of new cars sold by 10 percent. Lost tax revenues imply a carbon price of 1700 USD per metric tonne. But taking into account consumer and producer surplus, the tax exemption is welfare enhancing even before putting a value on emissions reductions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用2000年至2021年的汽车注册数据，以及价格表和税收规则，评估挪威为消费者选择电动汽车提供的激励措施。这些措施包括对化石燃料征税、电动汽车免征购车税，以及其他激励，如过路费折扣。我们发现，如果取消影响最大的激励措施——即电动汽车免征购车税，电动汽车市场份额将从2021年观察到的66%降至25%，新车销售的二氧化碳排放量将增加167%，新车总重量将减少22%，新车销售数量将减少10%。损失的税收收入意味着每公吨1700美元的碳价格。但考虑到消费者和生产者剩余，即使在对减排价值进行估值之前，税收豁免也能增进福利。

articles.title_en: The credibility of environmental policy stringency: Implications for sustainability in OECD Countries
articles.title_cn: 环境政策严格性的可信度：对OECD国家可持续性的启示
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the evolving interplay between environmental governance and sustainability outcomes, employing dose-response analysis to underscore the necessity of accounting for these interdependencies in formulating climate and emissions policies. Our empirical evidence indicates that regulatory measures are pivotal in advancing sustainability within OECD countries, though their effects differ across various dimensions. Notably, stringent environmental regulations initially exacerbate energy security vulnerabilities in nations below a specific threshold; however, once policy intensity surpasses the threshold, they contribute substantially to mitigating such risks. A comparable pattern emerges for renewable energy adoption, where enhanced policy rigor fosters greater consumption. Paradoxically, tighter regulations induce a marginal uptick in CO2 emissions. Moreover, insights from a dynamic panel threshold framework reveal that foreign direct investment (FDI) conditions the efficacy of environmental policies. As FDI rises, the beneficial influence of regulatory stringency on energy security and renewable utilization strengthens. Nevertheless, when FDI remains below 2.0, stringent environmental policies tend to elevate CO2 emissions, whereas, beyond this threshold, the relationship reverses, leading to emission reductions. These findings underscore the intricate, non-linear interactions between environmental policy and sustainability, highlighting the imperative for calibrated policy frameworks that acknowledge threshold effects.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了环境治理与可持续性结果之间不断演变的相互作用，采用剂量反应分析来强调在制定气候和排放政策时考虑这些相互依赖性的必要性。我们的实证证据表明，监管措施在推进OECD国家可持续性方面至关重要，尽管其影响在不同维度上有所差异。值得注意的是，严格的环境法规最初会加剧低于特定阈值国家的能源安全脆弱性；然而，一旦政策强度超过该阈值，它们将显著有助于缓解此类风险。可再生能源采用方面也出现了类似模式，政策严格性的增强促进了更大的消费。矛盾的是，更严格的法规导致二氧化碳排放量略有上升。此外，动态面板阈值框架的见解揭示，外国直接投资（FDI）调节了环境政策的有效性。随着FDI上升，监管严格性对能源安全和可再生能源利用的有益影响得到加强。然而，当FDI低于2.0时，严格的环境政策往往推高二氧化碳排放，而超过此阈值后，关系逆转，导致排放减少。这些发现强调了环境政策与可持续性之间复杂的非线性相互作用，突出了制定承认阈值效应的校准政策框架的必要性。

articles.title_en: Exploring the dynamic connectedness between uranium stocks and metals: Implications for portfolio diversification
articles.title_cn: 探索铀股票与金属之间的动态连通性：对投资组合多元化的启示
articles.abstract_en: As nations worldwide endeavor to address climate change, there is an ongoing debate on the transition toward low-carbon energy systems to mitigate greenhouse gas emissions. Nuclear energy, recognized as a significant low-carbon alternative, has garnered increased attention from governments and investors. In this context, this study employs a TVP-VAR time and frequency connectedness framework to examine the interrelationship between uranium stocks and precious and industrial metals using data on six uranium stocks and nine precious and industrial metals from July 14, 2010, to August 23, 2024. Our time-domain analysis demonstrates that Silver, Platinum, Zinc, and Copper function as net transmitters of return shocks, whereas uranium stocks act primarily as net receivers. In terms of volatility, three uranium stocks and Nickel emerge as net transmitters, while the remaining stocks (Gold, Silver, Palladium, and Copper) serve as net recipients. Our frequency domain results indicate that short-term spillovers predominate in both return and volatility connectedness, suggesting the transient nature of these effects. Furthermore, our findings underscore the importance of addressing climate risk as the interrelationships between uranium stocks and metals highlight their susceptibility to environmental and policy-related uncertainties. Furthermore, our portfolio analysis supports the hypothesis that uranium stocks may provide stability and diversification benefits during periods of volatility in metals markets. For policy insights, financial regulators need to improve their risk-monitoring systems amid these interactions. They should also consider the potential effects of investment in nuclear energy on investors in precious and industrial metals. Furthermore, portfolio managers can use uranium stocks as hedges against metal market volatility.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着世界各国努力应对气候变化，关于向低碳能源系统转型以减缓温室气体排放的争论持续不断。核能作为一种重要的低碳替代能源，已引起政府和投资者的更多关注。在此背景下，本研究采用TVP-VAR时频连通性框架，利用2010年七月14日至2024年八月23日期间六只铀股票和九种贵金属及工业金属的数据，考察铀股票与贵金属及工业金属之间的相互关系。我们的时域分析表明，白银、铂金、锌和铜作为收益冲击的净传递者，而铀股票主要作为净接收者。在波动性方面，三只铀股票和镍成为净传递者，而其余股票（黄金、白银、钯金和铜）则作为净接收者。我们的频域结果表明，短期溢出在收益和波动连通性中均占主导地位，表明这些效应的暂时性。此外，我们的研究结果强调了应对气候风险的重要性，因为铀股票与金属之间的相互关系凸显了它们对环境和政策相关不确定性的敏感性。此外，我们的投资组合分析支持铀股票可能在金属市场波动期间提供稳定性和多元化收益的假设。就政策启示而言，金融监管机构需要在这些相互作用中改进其风险监测系统。他们还应考虑核能投资对贵金属和工业金属投资者的潜在影响。此外，投资组合经理可以利用铀股票作为对冲金属市场波动的工具。

articles.title_en: Geopolitical risk and the global supply of rare earth permanent magnets: Insights from China’s export trends
articles.title_cn: 地缘政治风险与稀土永磁体的全球供应：来自中国出口趋势的洞察
articles.abstract_en: The energy transition is highly mineral-intensive, leading to substantial dependencies on a select group of producing countries, which may, in turn, spark new geopolitical tensions. Prominent among these critical minerals are rare earth elements (REEs), with China being the predominant producer. REEs serve as indispensable components in cutting-edge low-carbon technologies, particularly in the realm of offshore wind turbines and electric vehicles, through their crucial role in rare earth permanent magnets (REPM). This paper delves deep into the ramifications of geopolitical risk on the export of rare earth permanent magnets from China, the world’s leading supplier. Utilizing multiple linear regression on Chinese national export figures spanning from 2017 to 2024, the study uncovers that geopolitical risk exerts a markedly positive influence on the supply of rare earth permanent magnets. The results highlight that elevated geopolitical risks in the United States and Australia — China’s primary competitors in the upstream rare earth industry — positively influence REPM exports. Furthermore, the insights reveal that escalating geopolitical risks might significantly shape China’s strategic export volumes.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源转型高度依赖矿产资源，导致对少数生产国的实质性依赖，这可能反过来引发新的地缘政治紧张局势。在这些关键矿产中，稀土元素尤为突出，中国是主要生产国。稀土元素通过其在稀土永磁体中的关键作用，成为尖端低碳技术不可或缺的组成部分，尤其是在海上风力涡轮机和电动汽车领域。本文深入探讨了地缘政治风险对全球领先供应商中国稀土永磁体出口的影响。利用2017年至2024年中国国家出口数据的多元线性回归，研究发现地缘政治风险对稀土永磁体的供应产生显著的正向影响。结果表明，美国和中国在稀土上游行业的主要竞争对手澳大利亚的地缘政治风险升高，对稀土永磁体出口产生正向影响。此外，研究揭示，不断升级的地缘政治风险可能显著影响中国的战略出口量。

articles.title_en: Sanctions and inventories: Evidence from Russian energy firms
articles.title_cn: 制裁与库存：来自俄罗斯能源企业的证据
articles.abstract_en: We examine how Russian energy firms respond to international sanctions imposed by Western countries and their allies. The primary aim of these sanctions is to prevent Russia from accessing global trade markets. Using the sample of 13,319 Russian firms from 1994 to 2022, we find that sanctioned Russian energy firms hold significantly higher inventory levels compared to non-sanctioned firms. Sanctions have heterogeneous impacts across different firm characteristics. Large firms hold more inventory after being sanctioned, while highly leveraged firms significantly reduce their inventory levels. We also find that corporate inventory turnover is not significantly impacted, likely because sanctioned energy firms cannot promptly sell their products in response to the sanctions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了俄罗斯能源企业如何应对西方国家及其盟友实施的国际制裁。这些制裁的主要目的是阻止俄罗斯进入全球贸易市场。利用1994年至2022年间13,319家俄罗斯企业的样本，我们发现受到制裁的俄罗斯能源企业比未受制裁的企业持有显著更高的库存水平。制裁对不同企业特征的影响存在异质性。大型企业在受到制裁后持有更多库存，而高杠杆企业则显著减少其库存水平。我们还发现，企业库存周转率未受到显著影响，这可能是因为受制裁的能源企业无法迅速销售其产品以应对制裁。

articles.title_en: Energy regulation and industrial robot adoption: The role of human capital
articles.title_cn: 能源规制与工业机器人采用：人力资本的作用
articles.abstract_en: Energy regulations play a crucial role in enhancing firms' energy efficiency and environmental performance. However, their unintended effects, particularly on the adoption of industrial robots, have received limited attention. This paper leverages the implementation of China's Top 10,000 energy-consuming enterprises (TECE) program as an exogenous shock and employs a difference-in-differences methodology to assess the impact of energy regulations on industrial robot adoption and its potential underlying mechanisms. Additionally, the study examines the moderating role of human capital in shaping this relationship. To this end, we constructed firm-level variables for industrial robot usage and the intensity of energy regulation by integrating multiple micro-level datasets. Our findings indicate that energy regulations significantly reduce the usage of industrial robots. Specifically, the TECE project decreased the probability of regulated firms adopting industrial robots by 0.09 percentage points. Given that only 2.8 % of firms in the sample period used industrial robots, this impact is considerable. The deterioration of financial performance and increased R&D investment induced by energy regulations are likely channels for this effect. Furthermore, the energy regulation's negative impact is more pronounced for firms with higher levels of human capital. This is because such firms are more inclined to increase R&D investment, thereby crowding out investment in industrial robots.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源规制在提升企业能源效率和环境绩效方面发挥着关键作用。然而，其非预期影响，尤其是对工业机器人采用的影响，受到的关注有限。本文利用中国前10,000家能源消费企业（TECE）计划的实施作为外生冲击，采用双重差分法评估能源规制对工业机器人采用的影响及其潜在作用机制。此外，本研究考察了人力资本在这一关系中的调节作用。为此，我们通过整合多个微观数据集，构建了企业层面的工业机器人使用与能源规制强度变量。我们的研究结果表明，能源规制显著降低了工业机器人的使用。具体而言，TECE项目使受规制企业采用工业机器人的概率降低了0.09个百分点。鉴于样本期内仅有2.8%的企业使用工业机器人，这一影响相当可观。能源规制导致的财务绩效恶化和研发投入增加是这一效应的可能渠道。此外，能源规制的负面影响在人力资本水平较高的企业中更为显著。这是因为此类企业更倾向于增加研发投入，从而挤出对工业机器人的投资。

articles.title_en: Climate change and Carbon policy: A story of optimal green macroprudential and capital flow management
articles.title_cn: 气候变化与碳政策：最优绿色宏观审慎与资本流动管理的故事
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the macro-financial impact of carbon policy and the role of reserve requirements in managing climate-related transition risks. Empirical evidence shows that carbon policy shocks lead to a 0.7% output loss, a 0.3% rise in inflation, financial instability, and sectoral reallocation effects. Using a macro-financial DSGE model with environmental features, the model predicts that a 40% GHG emissions reduction results in a 0.7% output loss, while achieving net-zero emissions over 30 years causes a 2.7% medium-term output loss. The analysis underscores the banking sector’s amplified role during the transition and the benefits of pre-announced carbon policies in reducing inflation volatility by 0.2%. Utilizing a heterogeneous approach with macroprudential tools, I find that optimal macroprudential tools can mitigate the output loss by 0.1% and investment loss by 0.5%. Importantly, my work highlights the use of capital flow management in the green transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了碳政策的宏观金融影响以及准备金要求在管理气候相关转型风险中的作用。实证证据表明，碳政策冲击导致产出损失0.7%，通胀上升0.3%，金融不稳定，以及部门重新配置效应。使用具有环境特征的宏观金融DSGE模型，模型预测温室气体排放减少40%将导致产出损失0.7%，而实现净零排放需要30年，将导致中期产出损失2.7%。分析强调了银行业在转型期间的放大作用，以及预先宣布的碳政策在降低通胀波动性0.2%方面的好处。利用宏观审慎工具的异质性方法，我发现最优宏观审慎工具可以将产出损失减少0.1%，投资损失减少0.5%。重要的是，我的工作强调了资本流动管理在绿色转型中的应用。

articles.title_en: Research on the diffusion of electric vehicles based on dynamic games under the influence of environmental regulations
articles.title_cn: 环境规制影响下基于动态博弈的电动汽车扩散研究
articles.abstract_en: Environmental regulation policies and market demand are important factors driving the proliferation of electric vehicles. By introducing prospect theory, this study constructs the production decision model of automobile manufacturers based on evolutionary game and networked evolutionary game from both micro and macro perspectives. The results of theoretical and numerical simulation analysis show that: (1) increasing subsidies, carbon taxes, and market demand for electric vehicles are all conducive to the evolution of ‘ideal state’ of making all manufacturers produce electric vehicles; (2) when the mixed environmental regulation is adopted, the diffusion rate of electric vehicles is more obvious. Only when the carbon tax reaches a certain threshold, it can achieve full diffusion; (3) increasing the demand for electric vehicles can significantly promote the diffusion of electric vehicle production strategies among manufacturers.
articles.abstract_cn: 环境规制政策与市场需求是推动电动汽车普及的重要因素。通过引入前景理论，本研究从微观和宏观两个视角，基于演化博弈和网络演化博弈构建了汽车制造商的生产决策模型。理论与数值模拟分析结果表明：（1）增加补贴、碳税以及电动汽车的市场需求均有利于实现所有制造商生产电动汽车的“理想状态”演化；（2）当采用混合环境规制时，电动汽车的扩散速度更为明显。只有当碳税达到一定阈值时，才能实现完全扩散；（3）增加电动汽车需求能够显著促进电动汽车生产策略在制造商之间的扩散。

articles.title_en: Evaluating the role of information disclosure on bidding behavior in wholesale electricity markets
articles.title_cn: 评估信息披露对电力批发市场投标行为的作用
articles.abstract_en: Real-time information has the potential to improve market outcomes in wholesale electricity markets. However, transparency can also facilitate coordination between firms, raising questions over the appropriate extent of information disclosure. Despite this ongoing debate, there is a lack of understanding of the information employed by firms when bidding in wholesale electricity markets. Using data from Alberta, we leverage machine learning techniques to evaluate the real-time information firms use when forming their bidding decisions. We find that aggregate market-level variables emerge as important predictors, while detailed firm-specific information does not lead to a material improvement in predicting firms’ bidding decisions. These results suggest that firm-specific information, which has raised concerns because of its potential use in facilitating coordinated behavior, may not be required to promote efficient market outcomes.
articles.abstract_cn: 实时信息有潜力改善电力批发市场的市场结果。然而，透明度也可能促进企业之间的协调，引发关于信息披露适当程度的疑问。尽管存在这一持续争论，但对企业在电力批发市场投标时所使用的信息缺乏了解。利用阿尔伯塔省的数据，我们运用机器学习技术评估企业在形成投标决策时使用的实时信息。我们发现，总体市场层面的变量成为重要的预测因子，而详细的企业特定信息并未显著改善对企业投标决策的预测。这些结果表明，企业特定信息——因其可能被用于促进协调行为而引发担忧——可能并非促进高效市场结果所必需的。

articles.title_en: Greening through AI? The impact of Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones on green innovation in China
articles.title_cn: 通过人工智能实现绿色化？人工智能创新发展试验区对中国企业绿色创新的影响
articles.abstract_en: With increased adoption of artificial intelligence (AI) technologies, firms’ green innovation is expected to advance significantly. Using data from Chinese A-share listed firms, we employ a heterogeneity-robust staggered difference-in-differences model to evaluate the impact of AI on firms’ green innovation, leveraging the Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Development Pilot Zones (AIIDPZ) policy in selected Chinese cities as an exogenous shock. The results demonstrate that AIIDPZ policy implementation has significantly enhanced the quantity and quality of firms’ green innovation. Further analysis reveals notable heterogeneity in the policy’s effects in which low-polluting firms are more inclined to increase the quantity of green innovations, whereas capital-intensive and labor-intensive industries tend to prioritize improving innovation quality. Mechanism analysis reveals that increased AI adoption induced by the AIIDPZ policy significantly enhances firms’ operational efficiency, which subsequently fosters advanced green innovation. Based on these findings, we recommend promoting the further integration of AI across industries, with particular emphasis on leveraging AI-driven efficiency gains to advance green development.
articles.abstract_cn: 随着人工智能（AI）技术的日益普及，企业的绿色创新有望显著推进。利用中国A股上市公司的数据，我们采用异质性稳健的交错双重差分模型，以选定中国城市的人工智能创新发展试验区（AIIDPZ）政策作为外生冲击，评估AI对企业绿色创新的影响。结果表明，AIIDPZ政策的实施显著提升了企业绿色创新的数量和质量。进一步分析揭示了政策效应的显著异质性，其中低污染企业更倾向于增加绿色创新的数量，而资本密集型和劳动密集型行业则倾向于优先提升创新质量。机制分析显示，AIIDPZ政策诱导的AI采用增加显著提升了企业的运营效率，进而促进了先进的绿色创新。基于这些发现，我们建议推动AI在各行业的进一步融合，特别强调利用AI驱动的效率提升来推进绿色发展。

articles.title_en: Gasoline prices, gasoline price expectations, and inflation expectations in the United States
articles.title_cn: 美国汽油价格、汽油价格预期与通胀预期
articles.abstract_en: We analyze whether and to what extent gasoline price shocks influenced headline inflation, one-year gasoline price inflation expectations, and one-year inflation expectations in the United States using a partially identified Bayesian structural vector autoregression model. Results show that headline inflation and one-year inflation expectations increased instantaneously in response to gasoline price shocks, with the effects on one-year inflation expectations being considerably more persistent. The effects on one-year gasoline price inflation expectations were noticeably different. Although these expectations increased initially, they declined two months after the shock, with the effects dissipating shortly thereafter. Variance decomposition reveals that gasoline price shocks explained 66.18 %, 12.06 %, and 22.42 % of the variation in headline inflation, one-year gasoline price inflation expectations, and one-year inflation expectations, respectively.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们使用部分识别的贝叶斯结构向量自回归模型，分析了汽油价格冲击是否以及在多大程度上影响了美国的总体通胀、一年期汽油价格通胀预期和一年期通胀预期。结果显示，总体通胀和一年期通胀预期对汽油价格冲击即时响应上升，且对一年期通胀预期的影响更为持久。对一年期汽油价格通胀预期的影响则明显不同。尽管这些预期最初上升，但在冲击后两个月下降，且影响不久后消散。方差分解显示，汽油价格冲击分别解释了总体通胀、一年期汽油价格通胀预期和一年期通胀预期变动的66.18%、12.06%和22.42%。

articles.title_en: Forecasting the volatility of crude oil futures market: Does the simple 5-minute RV hold up?
articles.title_cn: 预测原油期货市场波动率：简单的5分钟已实现方差是否依然有效？
articles.abstract_en: Despite the extensive array of realized measures, there is no consensus on the optimal choice for forecasting oil price volatility. In this study, we examine the performance of 104 realized measures, with a particular emphasis on comparing these more sophisticated realized measures against the simple 5-min Realized Variance (RV). Our main findings are as follows: (1) The 5-min Realized Semivariance (RS) demonstrates the best performance among all realized measures; (2) Although many sophisticated realized measures theoretically surpass the simple 5-min RV, empirical evidence suggests that, aside from the 5-min RS, none of these sophisticated measures significantly improve the accuracy of oil price volatility forecasts; (3) The 5-min sampling frequency remains a reasonable choice for all realized measures in forecasting oil price volatility; (4) The portfolio based on the 5-min RS achieves the higher Sharpe ratio than most portfolios, with most portfolios failing to outperform the one constructed using the simple 5-min RV.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管已实现测度种类繁多，但对于预测油价波动率的最优选择尚无共识。在本研究中，我们考察了104种已实现测度的表现，特别强调将这些更复杂的已实现测度与简单的5分钟已实现方差（RV）进行比较。我们的主要发现如下：（1）5分钟已实现半方差（RS）在所有已实现测度中表现最佳；（2）尽管许多复杂的已实现测度在理论上优于简单的5分钟RV，但经验证据表明，除了5分钟RS之外，这些复杂测度均未能显著提高油价波动率预测的准确性；（3）对于所有已实现测度，5分钟采样频率在预测油价波动率时仍是一个合理的选择；（4）基于5分钟RS的投资组合获得了比大多数投资组合更高的夏普比率，而大多数投资组合未能超越使用简单5分钟RV构建的投资组合。

articles.title_en: Towards energy transition: Accessing the significance of artificial intelligence in ESG performance
articles.title_cn: 迈向能源转型：探究人工智能在ESG表现中的重要性
articles.abstract_en: Investigating the crucial role of artificial intelligence in enhancing ESG performance is of utmost importance, particularly for advancing the energy transition. In this study, we utilise the wavelet-based quantile on quantile regression (QQR) to capture the evolving impact of the Artificial Intelligence Enabler Index (AII) on the Global ESG Index (ESGI). Based on raw data, AII's impact on ESGI varies across different quantiles, indicating artificial intelligence doesn't always boost ESG performance. We use wavelet analysis to explore AII's effects on ESGI over various time horizons. AII has more negative impacts in the short term due to early technology stages, slow social adaptation, and limited ESG awareness. However, in the medium to long term, AII's positives may outweigh its negatives, fueled by technological progress, efficiency gains, wider ESG adoption, and artificial intelligence applications in ESG. Hence, our analysis reveals that artificial intelligence's inhibitory effect on ESG performance is more pronounced in the short run. Still, its enhancement effect becomes significant over the medium to long term. In the face of a new technological revolution and industrial transformation, we will offer practical advice to boost ESG progress using artificial intelligence while simultaneously fostering energy transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 研究人工智能在提升ESG表现中的关键作用，对于推进能源转型至关重要。在本研究中，我们采用基于小波的量子分位数回归（QQR）来捕捉人工智能赋能指数（AII）对全球ESG指数（ESGI）的动态影响。基于原始数据，AII对ESGI的影响在不同分位数上有所变化，表明人工智能并不总是提升ESG表现。我们利用小波分析来探究AII在不同时间跨度上对ESGI的影响。短期内，由于技术初期阶段、社会适应缓慢以及ESG意识有限，AII的负面影响更为显著。然而，从中长期来看，随着技术进步、效率提升、ESG采纳范围扩大以及人工智能在ESG中的应用，AII的正面效应可能超过其负面效应。因此，我们的分析揭示，人工智能对ESG表现的抑制作用在短期内更为明显，但其增强效应在中长期内变得显著。面对新一轮科技革命和产业变革，我们将提供实用建议，以利用人工智能促进ESG进步，同时推动能源转型。

articles.title_en: Vulnerability of energy firms to climate risk: Does fintech development help?
articles.title_cn: 能源企业面对气候风险的脆弱性：金融科技发展是否有帮助？
articles.abstract_en: Energy firms, given their importance to overall economic activity, are increasingly seen as sources of systemic risk. Considering the relation of climate-change risk to energy sources, it is sensible to consider energy firms as vulnerable to climate-change. We investigate whether fintech development bolsters energy firms (valuations and dividends) as these firms face greater climate risk. Using an international sample of listed energy firms from 2016 to 2023 (2379 (1972) firm-year observations for our firm value model) and ordinary least squares regression, we find that fintech development cushions the adverse impact of climate risk on energy firm values and dividends. Findings are robust to firm fixed effects and generalized method of moments models, additional control variables, and alternative measurements of value and dividends. Our results suggest that Fintechs may act as a channel for energy firms to withstand the negative repercussions of climate change, thereby supporting the efforts of regulators to promote Fintechs. Moreover, when confronted with high climate risk, our results suggest that managers could utilize Fintechs to increase firm value and dividends.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源企业因其对整体经济活动的重要性，日益被视为系统性风险的来源。考虑到气候变化风险与能源来源的关系，将能源企业视为易受气候变化影响是合理的。我们研究当这些企业面临更大的气候风险时，金融科技发展是否增强了能源企业（估值和股息）。使用2016年至2023年的国际上市能源企业样本（我们的企业价值模型有2379（1972）个企业-年度观测值）和普通最小二乘回归，我们发现金融科技发展缓冲了气候风险对能源企业价值和股息的不利影响。结果对企业固定效应和广义矩估计模型、额外控制变量以及价值和股息的替代测量方法均稳健。我们的结果表明，金融科技可能作为能源企业抵御气候变化负面影响的渠道，从而支持监管机构推广金融科技的努力。此外，当面临高气候风险时，我们的结果表明管理者可以利用金融科技来提高企业价值和股息。

articles.title_en: Do extreme temperatures exacerbate residential energy expenses burden in China?
articles.title_cn: 极端温度是否加剧了中国居民能源支出负担？
articles.abstract_en: Extreme weather outcomes induced by climate change have been academically confirmed, but the substantial impact on residents is less paid attention to, especially from the aspects of energy expenses burden. Based on multi-annual survey data, we identify how the temperature changes affect Chinese household energy expenditure burden. After the fixed-effects panel model estimating, some unique findings are obtained: (1) The rising frequency of extreme temperatures significantly augment the electricity and energy expenditure burden for Chinese households. With the annual rise in the number of extreme temperature days, the demand for both heating and cooling among residents correspondingly escalates. (2) The impact of temperature extremes across different regions and socio-economic groups are heterogeneous, with rural, northern and low-income households experiencing higher influence of temperature extremes on energy expenses burden. (3) The influence of extreme temperatures is asymmetric. Extreme high temperatures have a stronger impact on energy burden compared to extreme low temperatures. The compounded effects of numerous extreme temperature days and heavy energy expenditure burden significantly magnify the impacts of weather on households. According to these conclusions, policy suggestions are proposed to mitigate household energy expenses burden.
articles.abstract_cn: 气候变化引发的极端天气结果已在学术上得到确认，但其对居民的实质性影响，尤其是能源支出负担方面，受到的关注较少。基于多年调查数据，我们识别了温度变化如何影响中国家庭能源支出负担。通过固定效应面板模型估计，获得了一些独特发现：（1）极端温度频率的上升显著增加了中国家庭的电力和能源支出负担。随着极端温度天数的年增加，居民对供暖和制冷的需求相应上升。（2）不同地区和社会经济群体受极端温度的影响存在异质性，农村、北方和低收入家庭在能源支出负担上受到极端温度的更高影响。（3）极端温度的影响是不对称的。极端高温对能源负担的影响强于极端低温。众多极端温度天数和沉重能源支出负担的复合效应显著放大了天气对家庭的影响。根据这些结论，提出了缓解家庭能源支出负担的政策建议。

articles.title_en: Tax incentives for new energy vehicles challenge road infrastructure break-even
articles.title_cn: 新能源汽车税收激励挑战道路基础设施收支平衡
articles.abstract_en: Tax incentives for new energy vehicles (NEVs) have broader implications beyond their intended goals, raising concerns about the efficiency and affordability of these incentives. This study develops an integrated framework to compare the economic-wide implications of NEV incentives in China under eight scenarios considering different tax and non-tax incentives. Results suggest that lasting tax exemption promotes NEV replacement at a very high cost. For example, compared with the default policy to phase out the vehicle purchase tax exemption gradually, extending the tax exemption until 2035 will increase the NEV sales by 7 million at the costs of reducing related tax revenues by 3614 billion RMB, employment by 5108 thousand person-years, and GDP by 2091 billion RMB. On the contrary, phasing out the tax exemption as soon as possible will benefit road infrastructure financing (by increasing purchase tax and fuel excise tax revenues), job creation, and GDP growth without significantly harming NEV penetration. Policymakers should attach importance to the unintended impacts of NEV tax incentives, such that to achieve NEV promotion with affordable costs.
articles.abstract_cn: 新能源汽车（NEVs）税收激励的影响超出了其预期目标，引发了关于这些激励措施效率和可负担性的担忧。本研究构建了一个综合框架，在考虑八种不同税收和非税收激励情景下，比较中国新能源汽车激励的经济全局影响。结果表明，持续的税收豁免以极高的成本促进新能源汽车的替换。例如，与逐步取消车辆购置税豁免的默认政策相比，将税收豁免延长至2035年将使新能源汽车销量增加7百万辆，但代价是相关税收收入减少3614十亿元人民币，就业减少5108千人年，GDP减少2091十亿元人民币。相反，尽快取消税收豁免将有利于道路基础设施融资（通过增加购置税和燃油消费税收入）、就业创造和GDP增长，而不会显著损害新能源汽车的普及。政策制定者应重视新能源汽车税收激励的意外影响，以便以可负担的成本实现新能源汽车的推广。

articles.title_en: Development of centralized hybrid data envelopment analysis models to allocate emissions abatement for fossil fuel power plants during their current and replacement phases
articles.title_cn: 集中式混合数据包络分析模型的开发：用于化石燃料电厂当前及替换阶段的排放削减分配
articles.abstract_en: Many countries have long relied on fossil fuel power plants to ensure a stable electricity supply. However, the issue of pollution emissions from these power plants has raised widespread concerns. Because heat, power generation, and pollution emissions are jointly produced by consuming fossil fuels, previous research has typically employed standard hybrid data envelopment analysis (DEA) models. Since the fossil fuel power plants are under centralized management, it is crucial for government decision-makers to optimize the overall efficiency of all power plants rather than solely considering the efficiency of a single power plant. Therefore, this study presents two centralized hybrid DEA models. By applying the models proposed in this study, Taiwanese decision-makers can form optimal allocation policies for pollution emissions abatement among their 56 fossil fuel power plants during both the current and replacement upgrade phases. The significant findings of this study are as follows: First, the proposed model can efficiently allocate pollution emissions abatement among current fossil fuel power plants. Second, the proposed model can be further expanded to determine which fossil fuel power plants should be prioritized for replacement and how to effectively allocate policies for reducing pollution emissions among the remaining power plants.
articles.abstract_cn: 许多国家长期依赖化石燃料电厂以确保稳定的电力供应。然而，这些电厂的污染排放问题引起了广泛关注。由于热能、发电和污染排放是通过消耗化石燃料联合产生的，以往的研究通常采用标准的混合数据包络分析（DEA）模型。由于化石燃料电厂处于集中管理之下，政府决策者优化所有电厂的整体效率而非仅考虑单一电厂的效率至关重要。因此，本研究提出了两个集中式混合DEA模型。通过应用本研究提出的模型，台湾决策者可以在当前和替换升级阶段，为其56个化石燃料电厂制定污染排放削减的最优分配政策。本研究的重要发现如下：第一，所提出的模型能够有效地在当前化石燃料电厂中分配污染排放削减任务。第二，所提出的模型可以进一步扩展，以确定哪些化石燃料电厂应优先替换，以及如何在剩余电厂中有效分配减少污染排放的政策。

articles.title_en: The impact of financial stress, governance, and geopolitics on Europe's energy transition mineral trade
articles.title_cn: 金融压力、治理与地缘政治对欧洲能源转型矿产贸易的影响
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates how intra- and extra-territorial imports of energy transition minerals (ETMs) by the 27 Member States of the European Union respond to its energy transition parameters amidst the interplay of financial stress, mineral prices, electoral and political governance, and geopolitical turmoil. It utilizes monthly data from January 2004 to December 2023, also subdivided into two distinct periods covering the pre-Russia-Ukraine crisis period (January 2004–December 2021) and the Russia-Ukraine crisis period (January 2022–December 2023). The study applies the partial cross-quantilogram and wavelet local multiple correlation methods to manage heavy-tailed data characteristics. The findings indicate that Europe's ETM imports rise in line with the transition to clean energy despite volatility shocks from mineral prices and geopolitical events across all three periods. The combined effect of financial stress and ETM prices negatively affects Europe's mineral imports in bull markets, particularly due to volatility shocks during the Russia-Ukraine crisis period. In contrast, the interaction between electoral and political governance and geopolitics positively influences mineral imports, again except during the Russia-Ukraine crisis period. This study contributes to disentangling the transmission and volatility effects of pricing and geopolitical risk issues within the modeling framework. Finally, this research emphasizes the need for strategic resource management, risk mitigation, and improved governance to support Europe's mineral trade-driven energy transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了欧盟27个成员国的域内及域外能源转型矿产（ETMs）进口如何在其能源转型参数背景下，响应金融压力、矿产价格、选举与政治治理以及地缘政治动荡的交互作用。研究使用了从2004年一月至2023年十二月的月度数据，并进一步细分为两个不同时期：俄罗斯-乌克兰危机前时期（2004年一月至2021年十二月）和俄罗斯-乌克兰危机时期（2022年一月至2023年十二月）。研究采用偏交叉分位数图和 wavelet 局部多重相关方法来处理重尾数据特征。研究结果表明，尽管在三个时期内矿产价格和地缘政治事件带来波动冲击，欧洲的ETM进口仍随着向清洁能源转型而增加。金融压力与ETM价格的联合效应在牛市中对欧洲矿产进口产生负面影响，尤其是在俄罗斯-乌克兰危机期间的波动冲击下。相比之下，选举与政治治理同地缘政治之间的交互作用对矿产进口产生积极影响，但同样在俄罗斯-乌克兰危机时期除外。本研究有助于在建模框架内厘清定价和地缘政治风险问题的传导及波动效应。最后，本研究强调了战略资源管理、风险缓解和改善治理的必要性，以支持欧洲以矿产贸易驱动的能源转型。

articles.title_en: A multi-criteria classification approach for assessing energy poverty in the European Union
articles.title_cn: 评估欧盟能源贫困的多标准分类方法
articles.abstract_en: Energy Poverty (EP) poses a pervasive challenge within the European Union (EU), impacting both public health and the trajectory of sustainable development. Despite its prevalence, the existing body of literature addressing the measurement of EP in the EU remains limited. This study aims to contribute to the literature by employing a comprehensive approach to assess and classify the EP levels across 24 EU Member States (MSs) for the year 2020. We utilize the Tri-nC method of the ELimination Et Choix Traduisant la Realité (ELECTRE) family for multi-criteria classification, along with the Simos, Roy, and Figueira method for assigning weights to nine distinct criteria. The findings of our study indicate that 50 % of EU MSs exhibit a moderate level of EP, 29.17 % fall within the low EP category, and 12.5 % demonstrate a high level of EP. Notably, Bulgaria is classified within the range of Very High to High EP, while Romania falls between High and Moderate EP. Additionally, a discernible pattern was identified: Eastern and Southern European nations exhibit a notably high EP level. In contrast, the Scandinavian countries and Central Europe demonstrate a low EP level, while Western Europe and the Baltic countries fall into the category of moderate EP. These findings shed light on the regional disparities in EP across the EU, providing valuable insights for policymakers and stakeholders aiming to address this pressing issue.
articles.abstract_cn: 能源贫困（EP）在欧盟（EU）内部构成了普遍的挑战，影响着公众健康和可持续发展的轨迹。尽管它很流行，但欧盟现有的关于 EP 测量的文献仍然有限。本研究旨在通过采用综合方法对 2020 年 24 欧盟成员国 (MS) 的 EP 水平进行评估和分类，为文献做出贡献。我们利用 ELimination Et Choix Traduisant la Realité (ELECTRE) 系列的 Tri-nC 方法进行多标准分类，并使用 Simos、Roy 和 Figueira 方法为九个不同标准分配权重。我们的研究结果表明，50% 的欧盟成员国表现出中等水平的 EP，29.17% 属于低 EP 类别，12.5% 表现出高水平的 EP。值得注意的是，保加利亚属于极高 EP 至高 EP 范围，而罗马尼亚属于高 EP 至中等 EP 范围。此外，还发现了一个明显的模式：东欧和南欧国家的 EP 水平非常高。相比之下，斯堪的纳维亚国家和中欧国家的EP水平较低，而西欧和波罗的海国家属于中等EP水平。这些发现揭示了整个欧盟EP的区域差异，为旨在解决这一紧迫问题的政策制定者和利益相关者提供了宝贵的见解。

articles.title_en: From green to digital: Exploring the role of ecological footprints on cybersecurity risk
articles.title_cn: 从绿色到数字：探索生态足迹对网络安全风险的作用
articles.abstract_en: This paper investigates the link between firms' ecological footprints (EF) and cybersecurity risk in U.S. companies from 2007 to 2018. We find that higher EF is associated with lower cybersecurity risk. To address endogeneity concerns, we employ multiple identification strategies and confirm the robustness of the results. Mechanism analyses suggest that innovation and cash holdings mediate this relationship. Our heterogeneity analysis reveals that EF significantly reduces cybersecurity risk during stable periods. Furthermore, we find that companies with higher ecological footprints experience greater increases in cybersecurity risk when external uncertainty intensifies. The negative relationship between EF and cybersecurity risk is also more pronounced among firms with higher debt levels, while it becomes weaker for firms with stronger financial performance. These findings offer valuable insights for integrating environmental sustainability into firms' cybersecurity strategies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了2007年至2018年间美国公司的生态足迹（EF）与网络安全风险之间的联系。我们发现，较高的生态足迹与较低的网络安全风险相关。为了解决内生性问题，我们采用了多种识别策略，并确认了结果的稳健性。机制分析表明，创新和现金持有在这一关系中起到中介作用。我们的异质性分析显示，在稳定时期，生态足迹显著降低了网络安全风险。此外，我们发现，当外部不确定性加剧时，生态足迹较高的公司网络安全风险增加更多。生态足迹与网络安全风险之间的负相关关系在债务水平较高的公司中更为显著，而在财务表现较强的公司中则较弱。这些发现为将环境可持续性融入公司的网络安全策略提供了宝贵的见解。

articles.title_en: The role of artificial intelligence in renewable energy development: Insights from less developed economies
articles.title_cn: 人工智能在可再生能源发展中的作用：来自欠发达经济体的见解
articles.abstract_en: Global climate change and the growing pressure of energy transition pose complex challenges for less developed economies in achieving environmental sustainability. Artificial intelligence technology offers a promising avenue for advancing renewable energy development. This study analyzes the non-linear impact of AI technology on the renewable energy, drawing on AI patent data from 56 less developed economies from 2007 to 2022. The findings reveal a significant “inverted U-shaped” relationship. That is, AI initially drives renewable energy adoption, but as technological development reaches a certain threshold, its marginal benefits decline, potentially leading to negative effects. Moreover, institutional quality plays a crucial moderating role, with a strong rule of law enhancing AI's positive impact, while digital economic expansion exerts a weakening effect. Technological innovation acts as a key mediating mechanism, facilitating AI's influence on renewable energy adoption. Furthermore, the impact of AI varies across different renewable energy sources, with significant non-linear effects observed for biomass and wind energy, while its influence on solar and hydropower remains limited. These insights contribute to the literature on sustainable energy transitions and provide valuable policy implications for optimizing AI-driven renewable energy strategies in less developed economies.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球气候变化和能源转型压力日益增大，给欠发达经济体实现环境可持续性带来了复杂挑战。人工智能技术为推进可再生能源发展提供了一条有前景的途径。本研究利用来自56个欠发达经济体2007年至2022年的人工智能专利数据，分析了人工智能技术对可再生能源的非线性影响。研究结果揭示了显著的“倒U型”关系。也就是说，人工智能最初推动可再生能源的采用，但随着技术发展达到某一阈值，其边际收益下降，可能产生负面影响。此外，制度质量起着关键的调节作用，强有力的法治增强了人工智能的积极影响，而数字经济的扩张则产生了削弱效应。技术创新作为关键的中介机制，促进了人工智能对可再生能源采用的影响。进一步地，人工智能的影响在不同可再生能源类型间存在差异，对生物质能和风能观察到显著的非线性效应，而对太阳能和水电的影响则有限。这些见解有助于可持续能源转型的文献，并为优化欠发达经济体中人工智能驱动的可再生能源战略提供了有价值的政策启示。

articles.title_en: Energy transition and climate policy selection with stochastic demand: Evidence from Australian electricity generation expansion planning
articles.title_cn: 随机需求下的能源转型和气候政策选择：来自澳大利亚发电扩张规划的证据
articles.abstract_en: Australia’s Nationally Determined Contributions made in 2022, following the Paris Agreement in 2016, include a pledge to reduce greenhouse gas emissions to 43% below 2005 levels by 2050. This paper calibrates a General Expansion Planning (GEP) model to the Australian National Electricity Market (NEM) to forecast cost-efficient ways to meet future electricity demand while transitioning from fossil-fuel-based technologies to renewable energy sources. The model incorporates uncertainty in the Australian electricity market and employs the stochastic dual dynamic programming (SDDP) methodology to devise plans for the period from 2020 to 2050. By comparing the effects of carbon taxes and emissions caps, the study highlights differences between states with substantial initial coal resources and those without coal-powered plants. The imposition of carbon taxes or capped emissions can reduce emissions by substantial amounts, with carbon taxes being more cost-effective than emission caps for most states. The model predicts that without climate policies, emissions in NEM will initially fall by 32% from 2020 to 2035, but will then rise to 92% of 2020 levels by 2050. Conversely, implementing carbon taxes or emissions caps can reduce emissions by nearly 50% from 2020 to 2050.
articles.abstract_cn: 继2016《巴黎协定》之后，澳大利亚在2022做出的国家自主贡献包括承诺到2050将温室气体排放量减少到2005水平以下43%。本文根据澳大利亚国家电力市场 (NEM) 校准总体扩张规划 (GEP) 模型，以预测在从基于化石燃料的技术过渡到可再生能源的同时满足未来电力需求的经济高效的方法。该模型考虑了澳大利亚电力市场的不确定性，并采用随机双动态规划（SDDP）方法来制定2020至2050期间的计划。通过比较碳税和排放上限的影响，该研究强调了拥有大量初始煤炭资源的州和没有燃煤电厂的州之间的差异。征收碳税或排放上限可以大量减少排放，对于大多数州来说，碳税比排放上限更具成本效益。该模型预测，如果没有气候政策，NEM 的排放量最初将从 2020 下降到 2035 的 32%，但随后将在 2050 上升到 2020 水平的 92%。相反，实施碳税或排放上限可以从2020到2050减少近50%的排放。

articles.title_en: The puzzle of Carbon Allowance spread
articles.title_cn: 碳配额价差的谜题
articles.abstract_en: A growing number of contributions in the literature have identified a puzzle in the European carbon allowance (EUA) market. Specifically, a persistent cost-of-carry spread (C-spread) over the risk-free rate has been observed. We are the first to explain the anomalous C-spread with the credit spread of the corporates involved in the emission trading scheme. We obtain statistical evidence that the C-spread is cointegrated with both this credit spread and the risk-free interest rate. This finding has a relevant policy implication: the most effective solution to solve the market anomaly is including the EUA in the list of European Central Bank eligible collateral for refinancing operations. This change in the ECB monetary policy operations would greatly benefit the carbon market and the EU green transition.
articles.abstract_cn: 文献中越来越多的贡献指出了欧洲碳配额（EUA）市场中的一个谜题。具体而言，观察到相对于无风险利率的持续持有成本价差（C-spread）。我们首次用参与排放交易计划的公司信用利差来解释这一异常的C-spread。我们获得了统计证据表明，C-spread与这一信用利差以及无风险利率之间存在协整关系。这一发现具有相关的政策含义：解决市场异常最有效的方案是将EUA纳入欧洲央行合格抵押品名单，用于再融资操作。这一欧洲央行货币政策操作的变化将极大地有利于碳市场和欧盟绿色转型。

articles.title_en: How does environmental disclosure impede regional carbon emissions? Insights from extensive and intensive margins
articles.title_cn: 环境信息披露如何阻碍区域碳排放？来自广延边际和集约边际的见解
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the causal effect of environmental information disclosure (EID) on regional carbon emissions through the lens of extensive and intensive margins of industrial development. We find that, on average, EID reduces regional carbon emissions by 5.4 % in treated cities relative to the control group following the launch of the Pollution Information Transparency Index (PITI). We then decompose regional carbon emissions into those of new industrial entrants (i.e., the extensive margin) and incumbent industrial firms (i.e., the intensive margin). We find that EID not only deters the entry of industrial firms but also inhibits the entry of manufacturing and carbon-intensive firms. At the intensive margin, we find that EID reduces corporate carbon emissions mainly through cutting industrial output rather than improving energy efficiency. Further analyses indicate that the mitigation effect on carbon emissions is much more prevalent in regions with stringent enforcement, strong legal environments, and high Internet penetration rates. This study highlights the importance of informal regulation in mitigating climate change.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文通过工业发展的广延边际和集约边际视角，考察了环境信息披露（EID）对区域碳排放的因果效应。我们发现，在污染信息透明度指数（PITI）发布后，平均而言，相对于对照组，处理组城市的EID使区域碳排放减少了5.4%。然后，我们将区域碳排放分解为新进入工业企业（即广延边际）和现有工业企业（即集约边际）的排放。我们发现，EID不仅阻止了工业企业的进入，还抑制了制造业和碳密集型企业的进入。在集约边际方面，我们发现EID主要通过削减工业产出而非提高能源效率来减少企业碳排放。进一步分析表明，碳排放的减缓效应在执法严格、法律环境良好和互联网普及率高的地区更为显著。本研究强调了非正式规制在减缓气候变化中的重要性。

articles.title_en: From bytes to sustainability: Leveraging supply chain digitization for enhancing energy resilience
articles.title_cn: 从字节到可持续性：利用供应链数字化提升能源韧性
articles.abstract_en: The escalating global energy demand, coupled with the urgency of climate change, underscores the necessity for innovative approaches to achieve energy resilience and security. This study critically examines the interrelationship between global supply chain breadth, digital transformation, and energy resilience, addressing the key themes of this special issue across different aspects of energy security. This study used robust static panel data models for the assessment. Utilizing unbalanced data of 87 countries in 5 models and 95 countries in 6th model (2008–2022), the analysis results reveal a non-linear relationship between supply chain breadth and the five dimensions of energy security: availability, accessibility, affordability, acceptability, and developability while digitization had shown the moderating effect. The findings suggest that while the initial expansion of global supply chains may heighten vulnerabilities due to complexity and interdependence, long-term development fosters energy security through diversification and operational flexibility. Digital transformation is identified as a crucial moderator, stabilizing this dynamic by optimizing energy flow, reducing inefficiencies, and enabling an effective transition to renewable energy systems. Technologies such as blockchain and IoT enhance monitoring and management capabilities, mitigating disruptions and supporting sustainable energy governance. This study's findings provide actionable insights into how digitization strategies can be leveraged to align supply chain management with energy resilience objectives. By integrating supply chain theory with energy economics, this research offers a unique contribution to understanding the transformative potential of digital tools in mitigating energy risks while addressing broader sustainability goals. The policy implications emphasize the importance of digital infrastructure investment and cross-sector collaboration to design robust energy security strategies. This research study advances the discourse on supply chain digitization within the context of energy resilience, providing novel insights for policymakers, energy economists, and stakeholders aiming to navigate the challenges of a rapidly evolving energy landscape.
articles.abstract_cn: 全球能源需求的不断增长，加之气候变化的紧迫性，凸显了实现能源韧性和安全性创新方法的必要性。本研究严格审视了全球供应链广度、数字化转型与能源韧性之间的相互关系，从能源安全的不同方面回应了本期特刊的关键主题。本研究采用稳健的静态面板数据模型进行评估。利用87个国家在5个模型和95个国家在6个模型中的非平衡数据（2008-2022），分析结果揭示了供应链广度与能源安全的五个维度——可用性、可及性、可负担性、可接受性和可开发性——之间的非线性关系，而数字化则表现出调节效应。研究结果表明，虽然全球供应链的初始扩张可能因复杂性和相互依赖性而加剧脆弱性，但长期发展通过多样化和运营灵活性促进了能源安全。数字化转型被确定为关键调节因素，通过优化能源流动、减少低效以及实现向可再生能源系统的有效过渡来稳定这一动态。区块链和物联网等技术增强了监测和管理能力，减轻了中断并支持可持续能源治理。本研究的发现为如何利用数字化战略使供应链管理与能源韧性目标保持一致提供了可操作的见解。通过将供应链理论与能源经济学相结合，本研究为理解数字工具在缓解能源风险同时应对更广泛可持续性目标方面的变革潜力提供了独特贡献。政策启示强调了数字基础设施投资和跨部门合作对于设计稳健能源安全战略的重要性。本研究推进了能源韧性背景下供应链数字化的讨论，为政策制定者、能源经济学家和旨在应对快速演变能源格局挑战的利益相关者提供了新颖见解。

articles.title_en: Implications of alleviating unreliable electricity supply for energy poverty: Evidence from households in Benin
articles.title_cn: 缓解不可靠电力供应对能源贫困的影响：来自贝宁家庭的证据
articles.abstract_en: Energy poverty in Sub-Saharan Africa extends beyond access to electricity as it encompasses issues of affordability and reliability. In mitigating the adverse effects of frequent power outages and voltage fluctuations — that exacerbate financial burdens and hinder the ability to meet basic energy needs — households in this region often incur extra costs by relying on generators, voltage stabilizers and other alternative sources. Using Benin as a case study, this research examines the economic and poverty implications of these extra costs. By analyzing data from a national household survey, we assess how defensive expenditures—such as investments in power generators and voltage stabilizers—impact energy poverty. Our findings show that these additional costs make up a significant fraction (38 %) of household electricity expenditure, with the operating cost of power generators being the largest component. Importantly, 44 % of households are considered energy poor due to these extra expenses, a factor often overlooked in traditional energy poverty metrics. Using the probit regression model, we identify wealth status, homeownership, planned blackouts, and other factors, that significantly explain energy poverty measured with or without extra cost. Our results underscore the necessity of incorporating extra costs into energy poverty assessments to accurately identify affected households and design targeted interventions. This study contributes to the literature by highlighting the critical role of electricity reliability in energy poverty and providing policymakers with insights to develop more effective energy poverty alleviation strategies in Sub-Saharan Africa.
articles.abstract_cn: 撒哈拉以南非洲的能源贫困不仅限于电力获取，还包括负担能力和可靠性问题。在减轻频繁停电和电压波动的不利影响——这些影响加剧了经济负担并阻碍了满足基本能源需求的能力——该地区的家庭通常依赖发电机、稳压器和其他替代能源而产生额外成本。以贝宁为案例研究，本研究考察了这些额外成本的经济和贫困影响。通过分析全国住户调查数据，我们评估了防御性支出——如发电机和稳压器的投资——如何影响能源贫困。我们的研究结果表明，这些额外成本占家庭电力支出的显著比例（38%），其中发电机的运营成本是最大的组成部分。重要的是，由于这些额外支出，44%的家庭被视为能源贫困，这一因素在传统的能源贫困指标中常被忽视。使用probit回归模型，我们识别出财富状况、房屋所有权、计划停电和其他因素，这些因素显著解释了是否包含额外成本的能源贫困。我们的结果强调了将额外成本纳入能源贫困评估的必要性，以准确识别受影响家庭并设计有针对性的干预措施。本研究通过强调电力可靠性在能源贫困中的关键作用，并为政策制定者提供制定更有效的撒哈拉以南非洲能源贫困缓解策略的见解，为文献做出了贡献。
